<h2 class="section-heading">Dissertation Research</h2>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Aim 1 — COVID-19 Mortality Disparities and Vaccine Availability Among People with HIV in Florida</h3>
  <span class="project-tag">Survival Analysis</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Subdistribution Cox Hazard</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Multilevel Analysis</span>
  <span class="project-tag data">2M+ EHR Records</span>
  <span class="project-tag status-active">Revise & Resubmit — PLoS ONE</span>
  <p>Evaluated COVID-19 mortality disparities before and after vaccine availability among people with HIV in Florida using a 2M+ record EHR-linked statewide administrative registry. Applied subdistribution Cox hazard models and multilevel analysis to characterize mortality disparities across demographic and clinical subgroups before and after vaccine availability.</p>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Aim 2 — Spatial Co-Occurrence of HIV and COVID-19 Hotspots in Florida</h3>
  <span class="project-tag">Spatial Epidemiology</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Getis-Ord Gi*</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Firth Logistic Regression</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">ArcGIS Pro</span>
  <span class="project-tag status-active">Under Review — Health and Place</span>
  <p>Identified geographic co-occurrence of HIV and COVID-19 hotspots across Florida ZIP codes using Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot analysis. Applied Firth logistic regression for rare-event outcomes to examine individual and community-level determinants of hotspot co-occurrence. Produced ZIP code-level maps using ArcGIS Pro.</p>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Aim 3 — County-Level COVID-19 Prevention Policies and Incidence Among People With and Without HIV</h3>
  <span class="project-tag">Policy Analysis</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Longitudinal Trend Analysis</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Panel Data</span>
  <span class="project-tag data">County/Day Structure</span>
  <span class="project-tag status-active">In Preparation</span>
  <p>Examined associations between county-level COVID-19 prevention strategies and COVID-19 incidence trends among people with and without HIV, using a county-by-day panel data structure with policy indicator variables. Integrated surveillance data, ACS demographic variables, Social Vulnerability Index, RUCA codes, and vaccination coverage into a comprehensive analytic dataset.</p>
</div>

<h2 class="section-heading">Collaborative Research</h2>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Project D.A.I.L.Y. — Daily Adherence in Latino Youth Living with HIV</h3>
  <span class="project-tag">Behavioral Epidemiology</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">EMA</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">SEM</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Causal Bayesian Networks</span>
  <p>Coded and analyzed the Phase 2 baseline questionnaire for Project D.A.I.L.Y., a behavioral epidemiology study of ART adherence among Latino sexual minority men with HIV. The survey instrument incorporated ten validated PRO measures including the TSRQ, HIV-ASES, Brief COPE, CES-D, GAD-7, and HIV Stigma scales. Applied Ecological Momentary Assessment methodology and Structural Equation Modeling to characterize psychosocial barriers to adherence. Co-authored two peer-reviewed publications.</p>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Patient-Provider Relationships and HIV Viral Suppression</h3>
  <span class="project-tag">Causal Bayesian Networks</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">DAGs</span>
  <span class="project-tag data">EHR Cohort</span>
  <p>Co-analyzed data using Causal Bayesian Networks and directed acyclic graphs to assess the effect of patient-provider relationship quality on HIV viral suppression in EHR-linked cohorts in Miami-Dade County. Published in AIDS and Behavior (2024).</p>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Nonfatal Opioid Overdose Surveillance — Florida COVID-19 Context</h3>
  <span class="project-tag">Surveillance Analytics</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Trend Analysis</span>
  <span class="project-tag data">Florida Registry</span>
  <p>Analyzed trends in nonfatal opioid-related overdoses before and during the COVID-19 pandemic in Florida using statewide surveillance data. Published in Preventive Medicine Reports (2023).</p>
</div>

<h2 class="section-heading">Data Science Projects</h2>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Brain Tumor Detection in MRI Images Using Deep Learning</h3>
  <span class="project-tag methods">TensorFlow</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Keras</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">CNN</span>
  <span class="project-tag">Anvil Dashboard</span>
  <span class="project-tag status-active">DS4A 2021 Cohort</span>
  <p>Team 47 project developing a convolutional neural network using TensorFlow and Keras to classify brain MRI images as tumor or no tumor, trained on 6,123 standardized images from Kaggle, achieving 97.79% accuracy after 10 training epochs. Built and deployed a live interactive dashboard using the Anvil platform enabling remote MRI image upload with real-time tumor probability output.</p>
  <a class="project-link" href="https://dmx42ooxifccjbg6.anvil.app/QIN27DNNIXKIUE2ZXJIN6F4V" target="_blank">View Dashboard</a>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
  <h3>Organophosphate Pesticide Exposure Predictors in the US (1999-2020)</h3>
  <span class="project-tag methods">LASSO Regression</span>
  <span class="project-tag methods">Python</span>
  <span class="project-tag data">NHANES</span>
  <span class="project-tag status-active">DS4W 2022 Cohort</span>
  <p>Team 29 project analyzing NHANES federal health survey data (~60,000 individuals, 1999-2020) to identify variables associated with organophosphate pesticide exposure. Applied LASSO regression to combined demographic, dietary, and laboratory data across approximately 60,000 individuals. Found urine creatinine and blood lipid values as key predictors. Proposed use of these biomarkers for continuous monitoring in agricultural populations.</p>
</div>
